title: PrismCrawl YouTube API input
description: Search YouTube, get video and channel details, and download video transcripts through the PrismCrawl API as structured JSON. You need a PrismCrawl API key; each successful request uses one PrismCrawl credit, and failed requests are free.

prismcrawlApiKey.title: PrismCrawl API key
prismcrawlApiKey.description: Your PrismCrawl API key, sent to PrismCrawl as the x-api-key header. Create or rotate it in the PrismCrawl dashboard; new accounts get 100 free credits. The key is stored encrypted by Apify and is never logged or written to the dataset.

mode.title: What to fetch
mode.description: Choose what to fetch. Search uses Search query; the others use Video or channel ID.

query.title: Search query
query.description: For search: text to search YouTube for.

sp.title: Search filter token
sp.description: For search: the sp value from a YouTube search filter link, such as upload date or duration. Kept fixed while paging.

id.title: Video or channel ID
id.description: A video ID such as jNQXAC9IVRw, or a channel handle or ID such as @Google.

tab.title: Channel tab
tab.description: For channels: which part of the channel to list. Defaults to videos.

sort.title: Channel sort
sort.description: For channels: latest, popular, or oldest for videos, shorts, and streams; dd (date added) or lad (last video added) for playlists.

search_query.title: Search within channel
search_query.description: For channels: search the channel's videos and playlists.

about.title: Include channel details
about.description: For channels: also return the country, join date, total views, and links. Uses an extra source request.

language_code.title: Transcript language
language_code.description: For transcripts: preferred caption language, such as en. Falls back to the first available track.

title.title: Caption track title
title.description: For transcripts: pick a caption track by its title.

type.title: Caption type
type.description: For transcripts: set to use automatically generated captions.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: How many pages to fetch (search, videos, and channels only). The Actor stops early when PrismCrawl reports there is no next page. Each page is a separate PrismCrawl request and uses one credit.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country or storefront code, such as us or gb.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language, such as en. Not used for transcripts.

device.title: Device
device.description: Device presentation used for the source request. Leave empty for the default.

zero_trace.title: Zero trace
zero_trace.description: When enabled, PrismCrawl does not store the source or parsed response for these requests; only audit and billing metadata is kept. Results still appear in this Actor's dataset.
